tools.name: relay_whoami
tools.description: Return my identity (conv_id + roster row). Use after losing context.

tools.name: relay_discover
tools.description: List addressable conversations (filter by project/role). Sending still requires an exact conv_id.

tools.name: relay_join
tools.description: Join the roster with an Owner-supplied invite code.

tools.name: relay_send
tools.description: Send a TASK/QUERY/CLARIFY to another conversation. Target must be an exact conv_id.

result_requirement.description: what a good result must contain

ttl_s.description: seconds until it may no longer start (default 24h)

parent_request_id.description: parent request_id when continuing a chain

tools.name: relay_status
tools.description: Read the three-layer status (delivery/exec/return) of a request.

tools.name: relay_read
tools.description: Read the full result text + evidence references for a request.

tools.name: relay_cancel
tools.description: Request cancellation of a request I originated.

tools.name: relay_inbox
tools.description: My inbox: what awaits me, guidance on my running tasks, results to verify, my outbox.
